problem.quote: Right now, 40 customers have paid for the Ember Table Lamp

approach.quote: A Devin Oncall responder is pulling the incident, the monitor and the traces

evidence.quote: The trace shows three checkout.reserve spans in the same second, each reading available equals 3

must_mention.point: Impact in numbers: 40 paid orders for LH-LAMP-03 against 3 units, about $2,360
must_mention.evidence_quote: 40 customers have paid for the Ember Table Lamp, LH-LAMP-03, and we only had 3 units. That is about 2,360 dollars

must_mention.point: Evidence chain from monitor 48213771 to incident 2187 to a checkout.reserve trace to the reservation code
must_mention.evidence_quote: monitor 48213771 fired at 02:10 and opened PagerDuty incident 2187. The trace shows three checkout.reserve spans in the same second

must_mention.point: Primary cause is the unlocked read-then-write reservation, amplified by duplicate payment webhooks
must_mention.evidence_quote: the primary cause is the unlocked read-then-write reservation, and duplicate webhooks amplify it

must_mention.point: Mitigation until 08:00 that stops new sales of the SKU without a deploy or a manual stock edit
must_mention.evidence_quote: the SKU is unavailable on the Lamp Week price list and safety stock is above on-hand. No deploy and no manual stock edit

must_mention.point: Lite for the bounded triage, a full mode for the cross-service root cause, with the reason
must_mention.evidence_quote: Lite for the triage, because fetching the incident, the series and the order count is narrow and cheap. A full mode for the root cause

must_mention.point: The cache runbook was wrong and the oversell runbook was followed instead, with the deciding observation
must_mention.evidence_quote: the on-call followed RB-101, the cache runbook. It is wrong — the worker has had no cache since July

must_mention.point: Which integrations were live and which ran on the fixture shim
must_mention.evidence_quote: PagerDuty and Datadog ran on the fixture shim tonight, not live

misrecognised_words: "evt_9f2a7c01" may be transcribed as "event 9 F 2 A"

accuracy.anchor: All seven points stated with their numbers and ids; mm7 was brief (anchor: 26–30 = every point, one thin).

structure.anchor: Outcome → Evidence → Risk → Next action → Ask held in both updates; confirmed vs suspected labelled (anchor: 21–25 = order held throughout).

customer_relevance.anchor: Impact, money and the 08:00 owner in the first sentence; the alert storm absorbed in one line (anchor: 17–20 = numbers first, change absorbed).

brevity_and_fluency.anchor: Every segment within ±5 s; one filler in 9.4 minutes, no long pauses (anchor: 13–15 = all on target, fillers under 0.5/min).

recovery.anchor: Both objections acknowledged, bounded, evidenced and closed with an offer (anchor: 9–10 = pattern held twice).

stems: "Right now, 40 customers… It is costing…" — keep the number in the first five words.
"Confirmed: … Suspected: …" — you did it in the T+15 update; carry it into the closing update too.
"Integrations: live were … ; fixtures were …" — give the fixture/live line its own sentence, not a tail.
previous_run_comparison: Rerun of the same transcript (run 2): total 89 vs 90 in run 1; every dimension within 5 points.
